title: Daily briefing: Visit a huge climate experiment in the Amazon rainforest
title_zh: 每日简报：走进亚马逊雨林的大型气候实验
abstract: Step into the rainforest with climatologist David Lapola. Plus, watch an ‘invisible’ tattoo be revealed by ultraviolet light and explore PhD remuneration across Europe.
abstract_zh: 随气候学家大卫·拉波拉深入雨林。此外，观看由紫外线揭示的‘隐形’纹身，并探索欧洲各地博士生的薪酬情况。
